[AI engineering](../index.qmd) / Software and data foundations

Understand enough of the surrounding software to debug the system when the model is not the problem.

## What to understand

- **Python or TypeScript:** environments, dependencies, types, async I/O, exceptions and tests. Pick one working language first.
- **HTTP and APIs:** JSON, authentication, status codes, pagination, streaming, timeouts and retry semantics.
- **Data work:** parsing documents, SQL, joins, schemas, provenance, deduplication and versioned datasets.
- **Application structure:** a small service, persistent storage, background work, configuration and secrets.
- **Git and reproducibility:** reviewable diffs, lockfiles, a repeatable run command and small test fixtures.
- **Debugging:** isolate data, application, model and network failures rather than changing all four at once.

## How the pieces connect

These skills support every later area. An API timeout, broken parser or incorrect join can look like a model failure.

## A question to test

Take a small public document collection, parse it into a consistent schema, and make a repeatable script with one command and a test fixture.
